category_edits.rationale: Apply 0.05 label smoothing uniformly over real item classes in masked-item cross-entropy across all four datasets. This may reduce overconfidence while preserving equal masked-position weighting, normalized tied embeddings, masking, architecture and inference. Checkpoint shapes and the predictor remain compatible.

response.change_summary: Add 0.05 label smoothing to full-catalog masked-item cross-entropy, excluding padding and the exclusive mask token through the existing real-item logit slice.
